---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    # Trim extra spaces and convert country names to lowercase
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    # Relabel Y/N and group NA or messy entries as "Unknown"
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      .default = "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Save cleaned data so other pages can load it directly
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attack_counts <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower)

map_data("world") |>
  # Lowercase map region names so they match Country_lower
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = "Country_lower") |>
  # group = group keeps each country/island polygon connected properly
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = n)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_fixed(1.3)
```
